newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian 91-day T-bills sell at 5.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian 91-day T-bills sell at 5.5 percent.

text.p: Nigeria's Central Bank said on Monday it sold eight billion naira ($100.6 million) worth of 91-day treasury bills at a weighted average rate of 5.5 percent.
Bids totalled 10.888 billion, and the true yield will be 5.5756 percent.
Last week, the central bank sold eight billion naira worth of 91-day at a marginal rate of 3.5000 percent and a true yield of 4.039, compared with demand of 18.8 billion naira.
The bank said it also sold 720 million naira of 10-day treasury bonds at a weighted average rate of 3.0000 percent.
Bids received totalled 1.12 billion naira, and the true yield will be 3.0025.
Last week, it sold 365 million naira worth of 10-day treasury bonds at a weighted average rate of 3.0000 percent.
